title: 🤖 Project Manager: Add GitHub repository cloning
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Projects hosted on GitHub must currently be cloned outside Godot before they
can be imported. This adds an extra step and does not register the project
automatically.

Partly addresses https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6996.

## Additional information

Selecting **Import** now asks whether to import a local project or clone from a
URL. Each path then uses a dedicated flow:

- `Git URL` accepts an HTTPS GitHub repository URL without a file picker.
- `Parent Folder` has the only folder picker and determines where the
  repository-named project folder is created.
- Clone progress reports Git's receiving, delta-resolution, and checkout
  stages without blocking the Project Manager UI.

Godot clones the repository and its submodules, confirms that `project.godot`
exists at the repository root, registers the project, and opens it immediately
to match file-based import.

- Git must be installed and available through `PATH`.
- An existing repository-named destination must be empty; clone and
  missing-`project.godot` failures remain visible in the dialog.
- This deliberately preserves the repository history and branches. It does not
  use a ZIP download or a shallow clone.
- Remote ZIP import and projects below the repository root remain outside this
  focused GitHub repository-import change.

## Testing

- `python3 misc/scripts/file_format.py editor/project_manager/project_dialog.cpp editor/project_manager/project_dialog.h editor/project_manager/project_manager.cpp editor/project_manager/project_manager.h`
- `scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes vulkan=no metal=yes angle=no accesskit=no generate_bundle=yes -j8`
- Launch `bin/godot_macos_editor_dev.app` on macOS.

> [!INFO]
> *AI disclosure*: This contribution was authored by an autonomous AI agent, on
> behalf of a user, to add GitHub repository cloning to the Project Manager.
> The agent inspected the existing import flow and proposal, implemented the
> change, and ran the listed validation.
